corrections.reason: The printed glyph in the zoomed image is clearly ሠ-series ሣ (ይሣየጡ, Classical Ge'ez verb ሣየጠ/ተሣየጠ 'to buy provisions'), misread as ሳ.
Both the zoomed image and canonical Matthew 14:20 (as well as the Amharic gloss የተረፈውን አነሡ on L19) clearly read ወአንሥኡ ዘተርፈ ፍትታተ ('and they took up what remained of the fragments').
